news.analysis: The Broncos scored a season-high 38 points, but three of their five touchdowns came on the ground via Jonah Coleman -- while another came on defense. Nix, meanwhile, threw just one touchdown after throwing two in each of his previous two games. The Broncos quarterback will look to rebound against the Steelers in Week 12.
news.contents: Bo Nix completed 19 of 35 passes for 225 yards, one touchdown and one interception while rushing six times for five yards in the Broncos' 38-24 win over the Raiders in Week 11.
